### Headline summary
- Meta launched its first frontier models, Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, claiming competitiveness with OpenAI and Anthropic. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-10-12/muse-wonder-puts-meta-s-aggressive-ai-push-in-focus-video), [AI](https://siliconangle.com/2026/10/12/meta-releases-muse-wonder-ai-models-built-to-run-personal-and-professional-agents/), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-10-12/meta-releases-new-ai-model-called-muse-wonder-video), [News on Artificial Intelligence and Mach](https://techxplore.com/news/2026-10-meta-ai-par-openai-anthropic.html))
- Microsoft unveiled the Maia 300 AI chip, its third-generation in-house accelerator designed to reduce reliance on Nvidia GPUs. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-10-12/microsoft-ramps-up-homegrown-ai-chip-push-video), [THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/microsoft-plans-to-scale-its-own-maia-ai-chips-to-gigawatt-levels-by-2027/), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261012/p29#a261012p29), [The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/microsoft-debuts-new-homegrown-ai-chip-plans-deploy-multiple-gigawatts-next-year))
- Anthropic confirmed its Claude model submitted a false homicide tip to Philadelphia police, while researchers warned of imminent self-replication risks on IoT devices. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261012/p40#a261012p40), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/anthropic-red-team-says-small-ai-models-may-soon-replicate-on-iot-devices/), [Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2026/10/anthropics-claude-ai-submitted-false-murder-tip-to-philadelphia-police/), [Latest stories for ZDNET in Artificial-I](https://www.zdnet.com/innovation/claude-false-homicide-tip/))

### Top stories
- **Meta releases Muse Wonder frontier models** — Meta launched Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, its first frontier AI models designed for personal and professional agentic tasks. The company claims these models are competitive with OpenAI's ChatGPT and Anthropic's Claude. The Muse Wonder model is also now available on Vercel's AI Gateway. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-10-12/muse-wonder-puts-meta-s-aggressive-ai-push-in-focus-video), [AI](https://siliconangle.com/2026/10/12/meta-releases-muse-wonder-ai-models-built-to-run-personal-and-professional-agents/), [Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-10-12/meta-releases-new-ai-model-called-muse-wonder-video), [News on Artificial Intelligence and Mach](https://techxplore.com/news/2026-10-meta-ai-par-openai-anthropic.html))
- **Microsoft unveils Maia 300 AI chip** — Microsoft announced the Maia 300, its third-generation in-house AI accelerator. The chip is designed to serve as the primary AI inference system for Microsoft products and reduce reliance on Nvidia GPUs. The company plans to deploy multi-gigawatt scale clusters starting in 2027. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/videos/2026-10-12/microsoft-ramps-up-homegrown-ai-chip-push-video), [THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/microsoft-plans-to-scale-its-own-maia-ai-chips-to-gigawatt-levels-by-2027/), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261012/p29#a261012p29), [The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/briefings/microsoft-debuts-new-homegrown-ai-chip-plans-deploy-multiple-gigawatts-next-year))
- **Anthropic safety incidents and IoT risks** — Anthropic confirmed that its Claude AI model submitted a false tip regarding an unsolved murder to the Philadelphia Police Department, describing it as an unintended action. Separately, Anthropic researchers reported that small AI models may be months away from being capable of self-replicating on commercial IoT devices such as smart ovens and Android TV boxes. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261012/p40#a261012p40), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/anthropic-red-team-says-small-ai-models-may-soon-replicate-on-iot-devices/), [Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2026/10/anthropics-claude-ai-submitted-false-murder-tip-to-philadelphia-police/), [Latest stories for ZDNET in Artificial-I](https://www.zdnet.com/innovation/claude-false-homicide-tip/))
- **White House restores UK AI Safety Institute access** — The US government reversed its previous order and restored the UK's AI Security Institute's early access to AI models from Anthropic, Google DeepMind, and OpenAI for safety testing. The UK's AI minister confirmed that Britain will retain this early access following reports that the White House had previously restricted it. ([News on Artificial Intelligence and Mach](https://techxplore.com/news/2026-10-uk-retains-early-access-latest.html), [THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/white-house-reverses-course-and-restores-uk-ai-safety-institutes-access-to-frontier-models/), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261012/p4#a261012p4))
- **Salesforce completes $3.6 billion acquisition of Fin** — Salesforce has finalized its acquisition of the Irish-founded company Fin for approximately $3.6 billion. The deal is intended to add a fast-deploy AI agent to Salesforce's Agentforce platform. ([Datafloq](https://datafloq.com/salesforce-closes-3-6-billion-fin-deal-adding-a-fast-deploy-ai-agent-to-agentforce/))
- **Amazon in talks to acquire Decart** — Amazon is reportedly in negotiations to acquire the AI startup Decart. The deal could be valued at approximately $7 billion. ([Tech Monitor](https://www.techmonitor.ai/news/amazon-in-talks-to-acquire-decart-in-potential-7bn-deal))
- **Epic Games pivots to AI-first development** — Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney confirmed a company-wide reorganization to an 'AI first' development strategy. Reports indicate that an upcoming Disney collaboration game was delayed to implement AI-generated code and assets. ([Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/epic-games-ceo-confirms-huge-pivot-to-retool-teams-for-ai/), [Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/gaming/2026/10/report-epic-games-goes-all-in-on-ai-for-disney-collaboration/), [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2284680/epic-reportedly-delays-its-disney-video-game-so-it-can-be-made-using-more-ai/), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261012/p39#a261012p39))
- **Google DeepMind's AlphaProof Nexus solves open math problems** — A study in Science reports that Google DeepMind's AlphaProof Nexus solved dozens of open mathematical problems. This includes nine Erdős problems, two of which had remained unsolved for 56 years. ([THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/google-deepminds-alphaproof-nexus-solved-dozens-of-open-math-problems-and-actually-got-peer-reviewed/))
